connector.name: PinRAG
connector.registryDescription: MCP RAG: index PDFs, repos, YouTube, Discord, text; optional YouTube vision; query with citations.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package pinrag. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ndjordjevic account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
env.description: OpenRouter API key — required for the default chat LLM (PINRAG_LLM_PROVIDER defaults to openrouter). Get a key at openrouter.ai.

env.name: PINRAG_PERSIST_DIR
env.description: Absolute path to the Chroma vector store directory (recommended so indexes are not tied to the server process cwd).
